name: Gen1Recomp
description: Play Pokemon Red, Blue and Yellow in 3D natively on TrimUI handhelds using Gen1Recomp 0.1.77 and the Dramatic Shape voxel 3D mod. Needs your own US cartridge dump.
author: Carroarmato0

changelog.v0.2.0: Now a Tool pak: it appears under Tools instead of Games, so no ROM folder or launchable stub file is needed. The automatic ROM import now finds your dump in any folder NextUI treats as Game Boy or Game Boy Color, not just the two default folder names, and says so in the log when it finds no such folder. Upgrading from v0.1.0: delete Emus/<platform>/Gen1Recomp.pak and the Roms/Gen1Recomp (Gen1Recomp) folder by hand. Your saves are untouched -- they live in .userdata/shared/Gen1Recomp.
changelog.v0.1.0: Initial release, bundles Gen1Recomp 0.1.77 and the LOVE 11.5 aarch64 runtime.
